## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; _acme-challenge.example.com TXT
; add; keep the TXT records _acme-challenge already has
_acme-challenge 300 IN TXT "gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk"
_acme-challenge 300 IN TXT "LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0"

## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Add _acme-challenge.example.com TXT "gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"_acme-challenge.example.com","content":"\"gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk\"","ttl":300}'

# 2. Add _acme-challenge.example.com TXT "LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"_acme-challenge.example.com","content":"\"LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0\"","ttl":300}'
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
_acme-challenge:
  # keep the TXT values this name already has, and add the ones below
  - ttl: 300
    type: TXT
    values:
      - gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk
      - LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0

## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_acme_challenge" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "_acme-challenge.example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk"
  ttl      = 300
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_acme_challenge_2" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "_acme-challenge.example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0"
  ttl      = 300
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

# list the TXT values _acme-challenge.example.com already has here too (they were not read): this resource replaces the whole set

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_acme_challenge" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "_acme-challenge.example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 300
  records = ["gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk", "LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0"]
}
## terraform-route53 notes
fix.fn.incomplete {"name":"_acme-challenge.example.com","type":"TXT"}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Add: TXT records
   Name: _acme-challenge.example.com
   Values:
     "gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk"
     "LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0"
   TTL: 300
   Keep the TXT records the name already has.

Notes:
- Once the certificate is issued, the TXT values at _acme-challenge.example.com can be removed; leftovers do no harm but pile up.
- A wildcard and its base name are validated at the same name (_acme-challenge.example.com): keep both values until the certificate is issued.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=has+_acme-challenge+TXT+%22gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk%22%7C%22LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Ekle: TXT kayıtları
   Ad: _acme-challenge.example.com
   Değerler:
     "gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk"
     "LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0"
   TTL: 300
   Adın mevcut TXT kayıtları kalsın.

Notlar:
- Sertifika verildikten sonra _acme-challenge.example.com adındaki TXT değerleri kaldırılabilir; kalanlar zarar vermez ama birikir.
- Joker ad ve temel adı aynı adda (_acme-challenge.example.com) doğrulanır: sertifika verilene kadar iki değeri de tutun.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=has+_acme-challenge+TXT+%22gfj9Xq3Wr1Bm5zQXxZrW1zFeI6nY6cRgO0sIkWQfVbk%22%7C%22LoqXcYV8q5ONbJQxbmR7SCTNo3tiAXDfowyjxAjEuX0%22
